QF.id: VI Depository and its Business Partners_53

question.text: A public financial institution eligible to become a DP is defined under which section of the Companies Act, 2013?

explanation.text: The Logic: A public financial institution as defined in section 2(72) of the Companies Act, 2013 is eligible to become a DP. The Trap: The other section references do not contain the public financial institution definition relevant to DP eligibility. Note: Cite only the section 2(72) definition for DP eligibility; the workbook does not list named institutions as the basis for this definition.
